chinese: 減弱；緩和；減少；降低；（法律）廢除
definition: to become or make less intense; to reduce in amount or value; (law) to put an end to
example: The wind finally abated near dawn.

chinese: 深奧的；難以理解的；晦澀的
definition: difficult to understand; recondite; obscure
example: The article made an abstruse theory unusually clear.

chinese: 敏銳；精明；洞察力；判斷力
definition: the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions; keen insight
example: Her financial acumen helped the small firm survive.

chinese: （情感或態度）矛盾的；搖擺不定的
definition: having mixed or conflicting feelings about something; uncertain
example: He was ambivalent about leaving a secure position.

chinese: 異常；反常現象；異常事物
definition: something that deviates from what is standard or expected; an irregularity
example: Researchers first dismissed the result as an anomaly.

chinese: 安撫；平息；姑息；綏靖；滿足（慾望）
definition: to pacify or placate by meeting demands; to make concessions to an aggressor; to satisfy or relieve (hunger, thirst)
example: The concession failed to appease the critics.

chinese: 任意的；武斷的；專斷的；專橫的
definition: based on whim or chance rather than reason; random; using unrestrained power
example: The cutoff date seemed arbitrary.

chinese: 勤勉的；刻苦的；專心仔細的；孜孜不倦的
definition: showing great care, attention, and persistent effort
example: Her assiduous archival work uncovered the missing letters.

chinese: 樸素的；無裝飾的；嚴厲的；嚴峻的；苦行的
definition: plain and without ornament; severe or strict in manner; without comforts; ascetic
example: The building's austere interior has almost no ornament.

chinese: v. 支持；加強；鼓舞；n. 長枕；支撐物
definition: to support or strengthen; to boost; a long pillow; a support
example: New evidence bolstered the original conclusion.

chinese: 反覆無常的；變化莫測的；任性的
definition: given to sudden changes of mood or behavior; unpredictable
example: A capricious policy makes long-term planning difficult.

chinese: 謹慎的；周全的
definition: careful to consider all circumstances and risks; prudent
example: The board was circumspect about making promises.

chinese: 有說服力的；令人信服的；切題的
definition: clear, logical, and convincing; pertinent
example: She offered a cogent explanation for the discrepancy.

chinese: 安撫的；和解的；調和的
definition: intended to placate or restore goodwill; willing to make concessions
example: His conciliatory tone reopened negotiations.

chinese: 推測的；猜測性的
definition: based on guesswork or incomplete evidence
example: Without records, the date remains conjectural.

chinese: 有害的；有毒的
definition: causing harm or damage
example: Chronic noise can have deleterious effects on health.

chinese: 缺乏自信的；羞怯的；拘謹的
definition: lacking self-confidence; shy and reserved
example: The normally diffident student gave a forceful defense.

chinese: 武斷的；教條的；自以為是的
definition: asserting opinions as undeniably true
example: A dogmatic approach leaves little room for contrary evidence.

chinese: adj. 兼容並蓄的；多元的；折衷的；n. 折衷主義者
definition: drawing ideas or style from a wide range of sources; a person who selects from various sources
example: The course has an eclectic reading list.

chinese: 使衰弱；使無力；削弱
definition: to drain of energy or vitality; to weaken
example: Weeks of uncertainty enervated the team.

chinese: 模稜兩可的；含糊的；可疑的
definition: open to more than one interpretation, often intentionally; of uncertain nature; questionable
example: The minister gave an equivocal response.

chinese: 博學的；學識淵博的
definition: having or showing great knowledge or learning
example: The lecture was erudite without being inaccessible.

chinese: 使惡化；使加劇
definition: to make a problem, situation, or feeling worse
example: The delay exacerbated an already tense situation.

chinese: 一絲不苟的；挑剔的；過分講究的；有潔癖的
definition: very attentive to accuracy and detail; hard to please; excessively particular; very concerned about cleanliness
example: A fastidious editor checked every citation.

chinese: 偶然的；巧合的；幸運的
definition: happening by chance; lucky or fortunate by coincidence
example: A fortuitous meeting led to the collaboration.

chinese: 陳腐的；老套的；陳詞濫調的
definition: overused and lacking originality; trite
example: The speaker relied on hackneyed slogans.

chinese: 反傳統者；打破舊習的人；（宗教）破壞聖像者
definition: a person who attacks cherished beliefs or institutions; a destroyer of religious images
example: The critic earned a reputation as an iconoclast.

chinese: 初步的；未成形的；剛開始的；雜亂的
definition: just begun; only partly formed or organized; incoherent
example: The committee turned an inchoate idea into a proposal.

chinese: 言簡意賅的；簡潔的；寡言的
definition: using very few words; concise to the point of seeming rude or mysterious; terse
example: Her laconic reply ended the discussion.

chinese: 清晰易懂的；明晰的；神智清醒的；清澈的
definition: expressed clearly; easy to understand; mentally clear; bright or translucent
example: The diagram makes the process lucid.

chinese: 減輕；緩和；（法律）從輕
definition: to make less severe or painful; to alleviate; (law) to lessen the gravity of
example: Shade trees can mitigate urban heat.

chinese: 頑固的；固執的；冷酷無情的
definition: stubbornly refusing to change; resistant to persuasion; unmoved by pity
example: The negotiator remained obdurate despite new evidence.

chinese: 晦澀的；難懂的；不透明的；不透光的
definition: hard to understand; not open or transparent; not allowing light to pass through
example: The agency's opaque process invited suspicion.

chinese: 矛盾的；似非而是的；自相矛盾的
definition: seemingly contradictory but possibly true; self-contradictory
example: It is paradoxical that more choice can reduce satisfaction.

chinese: 務實的；實用的；實用主義的；（語言學）語用的
definition: dealing with things sensibly and practically; based on practical results; (linguistics) relating to pragmatics
example: They adopted a pragmatic compromise.

chinese: 暫定的；臨時的；暫時的
definition: arranged for the present, possibly to be changed later; temporary
example: The estimate is provisional until more data arrive.

chinese: 沉默寡言的；有所保留的；含蓄的
definition: not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily; reserved; inclined to be silent
example: Witnesses were reticent about the details.

chinese: 樂觀的；自信的；（臉色）紅潤的
definition: optimistic or confident, especially in a difficult situation; (of complexion) ruddy
example: Analysts were less sanguine about the second quarter.

chinese: 一絲不苟的；嚴謹的；有道德原則的；正直的
definition: extremely careful and thorough; concerned to avoid doing wrong; principled
example: The study used scrupulous controls.

chinese: 似是而非的；貌似有理的；虛有其表的
definition: superficially plausible but actually wrong; misleadingly attractive
example: The argument is attractive but specious.

chinese: 薄弱的；牽強的；空洞的；稀薄的；纖細的
definition: very weak or slight; lacking substance; thin or rarefied
example: The conclusion rests on a tenuous analogy.

chinese: 一針見血的；尖銳有力的；鮮明的
definition: sharply incisive and effective; vigorous; clear-cut
example: Her trenchant critique changed the debate.

chinese: 無所不在的；隨處可見的；普遍存在的
definition: present, appearing, or found everywhere
example: Sensors have become ubiquitous in modern devices.

chinese: 猶豫不決；搖擺不定；擺動
definition: to alternate between opinions or choices; to waver; to sway back and forth
example: The council continued to vacillate between the two plans.

chinese: 證明正確；為…平反；洗清（罪名）；證實
definition: to show to be right or justified; to clear of blame or suspicion; to confirm
example: Later evidence vindicated the researcher's method.
